The M40 to M49 race saw an excellent victory for the new supervet Nigel Gates of Brighton & Hove. Belgrave had just two competitors, both in the M45 section.
Leo was looking for his 5th win of the winter season around this course but had to face super-vet Nigel Gates - 4th in the Southern and fresh from a world record 3k the week before.
In fact he won no less than four of those popular VAC cross country races, with a best time of 26:32, and was only beaten in the fifth by Brighton's Nigel Gates.
